The '''Raid on the Trade Federation''' base took place prior to the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], occurring when [[Nym/Legends|Nym's]] [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]] and the [[Mere Resistance]] staged an assault on a Trade Federation Base to allow [[Jinkins]] to slice into the Trade Federation's planetary network to ascertain the location of [[Spacestation 1138]] where members of the Resistance were being held, most notably [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Orsai]].

==Prelude==
The [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] band Lok Revenants was engaged in a struggle against the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] for control of the [[Karthakk system]]. After joining forces with the [[Mere]] [[Revenant (Mere)|Revenants]], Nym agreed to rescue captured [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]]. But first they had to find them.

==The battle==
Nym and Jinkins stormed the base but were being overrun by the Trade Federations forces. The timely arrival of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] and [[Reti]] were enough to buy time for Jinkins to acquire the location and access codes to Spacestation 1138 by [[Slicer/Legends|slicing]] into the Trade Federation's planetary network. [[Trade Federation droid bomber|Droid bombers]] began coming in waves from two [[Trade Federation Battleship (aquatic)|Battleships]] but with the combined efforts of the [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] the mission was a success. When the battleships were destroyed, the remaining fighters lost their control signal and were destroyed.

==Aftermath==
The codes taken from the system would be invaluable for their planned [[Raid on Spacestation 1138|raid on the station]] which would be the next mission for the Revenants.

==Behind the scenes==
This article was created based on the mission "Unlikely Allies" in the video game ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Starfighter]]''. The bonus objective is to destroy the Federation battleships.
